newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Glencore to win Sri Lanka diesel/jet import tender.
newsitem.headline: Glencore to win Sri Lanka diesel/jet import tender.

text.p: Swiss trader Glencore is expected to win Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) middle-distillates import tender with the best offer of 89 cents per barrel over Singapore spot quotes, a CPC source said on Thursday.
The premium level is the same for both 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and jet fuel, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo for October 11-12 delivery.
CPC sought 160,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel in the tender which attracted six offers.
The tender closed on September 18 and is expected to be awarded this evening.
In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought 145,000 barrels of diesel from Caltex at around $1.77 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes for September 19-20 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
